scripts.build: pnpm --filter @matra/core run build && pnpm --filter @matra/command run build && pnpm --filter @matra/math run build && pnpm --filter @matra/math-compute-engine run build && pnpm --filter @matra/graphics run build && pnpm --filter @matra/html run build && pnpm --filter @matra/styles run build && pnpm --filter @matra/kernel run build && pnpm --filter @matra/website run build && cargo build --manifest-path crates/matra-seed/Cargo.toml
